turn.content: I have all the evidence needed. The billing position confirms invoicing is within received (so no quantity/price issue), and the only issue — payment terms — is confirmed by both the vendor master record and the signed contract.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "payment_terms_mismatch", "line": null, "cause": "payment_terms_shorter", "evidence": [{"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV/2026/10/0433", "detail": "Invoice states payment_terms_days = 7, i.e. payment demanded within 7 days of the 2026-10-16 invoice date."}, {"kind": "vendor", "ref": "V-040", "detail": "Vendor master record for Pacific Foods Group (V-040) sets payment_terms_days = 30."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-040#5.1", "detail": "\"The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.\""}], "explanation": "The invoice demands payment in 7 days while the agreed terms on file for this vendor are 30 days, as confirmed by contract clause KTR-V-040#5.1, so the invoiced terms are shorter than the agreed terms by 23 days."}]}
